references.text: Jesus uses similar language about cutting off a hand or foot and tearing out an eye if they lead to sin, in order to avoid hell.
Jesus repeats the message about cutting off the hand or foot and tearing out the eye if they lead to sin, to avoid entering hell.
The prophet Isaiah speaks of the Lord's hand not being too short to save, which stands in contrast to the idea of cutting off one's own hand to avoid sin.
The book of Psalms speaks of great peace for those who love God's law, and that nothing can make them stumble, in contrast to the idea that a body part can lead to sin.
